name: Knee Plica Syndrome
definition: Symptomatic irritation of a synovial plica, most commonly medial, producing anterior/medial knee pain and snapping after overuse or trauma.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; MRI may help exclude other pathology.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, tendon, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Arthroscopic resection is reserved for persistent clearly localized cases.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-Sandhi soft-tissue phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Symptomatic irritation of a synovial plica, most commonly medial, producing anterior/medial knee pain and snapping after overuse or trauma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
